answer.design_quote: Eligible studies were randomized controlled trials involving participants aged <19 years in hospital settings. Two reviewers independently screened, extracted data, assessed risk of bias, and evaluated the certainty of evidence. Random-effects meta-analyses were performed using the Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman method.
answer.k_quote: Thirteen randomized controlled trials were included, of which 7 were eligible for meta-analyses.
